question: Who was the first representative of the English East India Company to visit the court of Mughal Emperor Jahangir in 1609?
explanation: Captain William Hawkins was the first representative of the English East India Company to visit the court of Mughal Emperor Jahangir in April 1609, carrying a letter from King James I of England to seek trade permissions.

question: In which language did Captain William Hawkins converse with Mughal Emperor Jahangir, which greatly pleased the Emperor?
explanation: William Hawkins was fluent in Turki (Turkish), the ancestral language of the Mughals. This allowed him to converse directly with Jahangir without an interpreter, which greatly pleased the Emperor.
